newsitem.title: UK: European jet premiums hold steady but market long.
newsitem.headline: European jet premiums hold steady but market long.

text.p: European jet fuel premiums held their ground on Friday but traders said supply was plentiful and expected a softening in prices next week.
Cargo premiums were still talked around June IPE gas oil +$18 a tonne cif NWE after a cargo traded at that level into ARA on Thursday.
Unusually, fob barges were assessed at parity to cif cargoes, but traders expected some softening of levels soon.
"The whole of Europe is quite long both in the north and the Med," said one trader.
Underlying IPE gas oil futures gained $1.00 to trade at $173.00 a tonne at 1546 GMT on Friday.
